name: Suren
source:
The general of the Nasura army, Slen holds the most authority on the battlefield, second only to the king. Since he treats women with a brash and forceful attitude, the Rusu women are afraid of him. However, his subordinates place their absolute trust in him. Despite his "wild" appearance, Slen is actually quite quick-witted and observant.

[Based on the [URL=http://ignote.net/operetta2/benibana/benibana2/character.html#TabPanel04]official website profile[/URL].]
